narrative.overview: Every panel is a printed label or docket lying on a cool grey desk. Paper is near-white, edged by a hairline, and headed by a 2px ink rule. A near-black ink rail carries the brand, the three screens and the controls. Fields, buttons and tags are tools on the desk: 2px corners, 1px borders, no decoration. Density is high and exact; state is carried by five fixed colors and one cobalt accent. The board fits the window and never scrolls on desktop.
keyCharacteristics: Ink rail plus paper panels with a 2px ink top rule on a grey desk.
Flat at rest; the only shadow belongs to the floating toast.
One accent (blue); five fixed order-state colors; everything else is neutral.
Hanken Grotesk for text, JetBrains Mono for order numbers and counts, both served locally.
Light and dark themes through the same token names; auto by OS, overridable by the rail toggle.

rules.name: The Five States Rule
rules.body: An order's state is always one of the five --st-* tokens, in the same hue in chips, tiles, chart series and matrix columns. Never introduce a sixth state color or reuse a state hue for decoration.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Cobalt means selected, actionable or focused. It is never a fill for data series or status.

rules.name: The Heat Tint Rule
rules.body: Matrix cells are tinted with color-mix on the state token at 14-60%, scaled per column by its maximum; zero cells stay unfilled and muted.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number uses tabular figures; identifiers and counts in markers use the mono face.

rules.name: The Scale Rule
rules.body: Sizes are rem against --u; never set px type except chart canvas text, which reads --u via fz().

rules.name: The Flat Desk Rule
rules.body: Panels, tiles, markers and buttons carry no shadow at rest or on hover; hover changes border to ink or fills paper-2.

dos: Do head every panel with the 2px ink rule over a paper body with a 1px hairline.
Do read order-state colors only from --st-if/ip/nf/np/ca.
Do keep motion to 100-160ms ease-out state feedback and respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Do write figures with tabular numerals and identifiers in JetBrains Mono.
Do define new colors as light/dark token pairs and use --u for all sizes.
donts: Don't wrap metrics in separate soft-shadowed cards or enlarge a single hero number; KPIs stay one label with fields.
Don't add shadows to panels or controls; the toast alone floats.
Don't use the cobalt accent for status or data series.
Don't put an uppercase caption above panel titles or headings; uppercase legends belong to fields, KPI names and column heads only.
Don't load fonts, scripts or images from the internet; everything is served locally.
knownGaps: TV legibility is the desktop board enlarged on a smaller reference canvas, not a recomposition for a room screen.
The closing combo chart's second series (muted) is unverified: demo data has one closed month.
narrative.provenance: Only raster: public/img/logo.png, the user's pre-existing corporate logo (Electrolux wordmark), extracted unchanged from the v2.6 page data URI, shown on a fixed #fff plate. No generated assets.
